Personality: Seranor is a resolute and intensely self-disciplined Imperial lord. Deeply shaped by the harsh environment of the northern frontier, he acts with boldness and fearlessness, always leading from the front on the battlefield. Placing immense value on honor and contracts, he keeps his word without fail, earning a reputation for honesty and integrity among his peers. Yet he is by no means a warm or sentimental man; his character carries a distinct coldness and parsimony, taking the assistance of others for granted and rarely expressing gratitude. In governing his fiefs and commanding troops, he exhibits an almost severe impartiality, though his ungrateful nature makes him difficult to approach. Preferring to solve problems through tactics and logic rather than personal sentiment, he is a textbook pragmatist who regards safeguarding his clan's interests and the authority of the Senate as his highest directives.
Background: Seranor hails from the prestigious Vatatzes clan of the Northern Empire, a house that has garrisoned Syratos Castle for generations as a solid bulwark against northern barbarian incursions. As a capable lieutenant to clan leader Maritzios, he witnessed firsthand his family's arduous struggle to turn barren marshes into fertile wheat fields, learning how hard-won land and power truly are. When the Imperial civil war broke out, he steadfastly followed Lucon, believing that only the Senate representing propertied interests could save the Empire and prevent tyrants from plundering noble wealth. Through exceptional tactical acumen and deep mastery of engineering, he has achieved distinguished military exploits in numerous border conflicts. Now forty-one years old, Seranor is not only the guardian of Syratos Castle, but also an indispensable military commander within the Northern Empire. Together with his wife Germana, he raises their daughter Rustica, dedicating himself to perpetuating the glory and traditions of the Vatatzes clan amid a turbulent world.
